石镜映霞
长刀门易主的事情并未在平川城内传出半点风声，然而长刀门与五音亭联姻取消的事情却是成为了平川城内的焦点话题。
五音亭李长老在来平川城的第二天便直接带人离开了，随后赵家除了派人收回之前送出的请帖，一直闭门不出。
整个长刀门好像与世隔绝了一般，即便有与赵家父子相熟的宾客登门拜访，长刀门除了派出一个老管家赔礼道歉外，赵家父子却是一直未曾露面。
就在城内的百姓对此议论纷纷的时候，海面上，隋缘一行乘坐的船只却是抵达了英雄会的举办地，映霞岛。
这映霞岛乃是位于东海郡正东方向的一座方圆十几里的小岛，岛上原本只有寥寥数百人世代生活在此，后来东海老人在此隐居，却也教出了几个弟子，在江湖上闯出了不小的名号。
随着船只渐渐靠岸，船上的乘客大多来到甲板上远远眺望这座孤悬在海外的岛屿，此刻正是正午时分，阳光热烈的倾斜而下，众人眯着眼睛打量着眼前的这座小岛，却也并未看出有什么出奇的地方。
大船最上面一层，聂鹏与李素、陈倩两人站在门外的露台上，同样也在观赏这江湖上久负盛名的映霞岛。
聂鹏身为靖安城五虎帮的二当家，当然有资格在最上层占据一个房间，而李素和陈倩两人却也是沾了聂鹏的光得以留在最上层。
“这映霞岛地势西高东低，“看着眼前被碧蓝色海水包围的岛屿，聂鹏有些感慨的说到，”
景色最好的地方当是‘观镜台‘那里，每天日出时分，朝阳跃出海面映照在石壁上，那景色，当真称得上是人间胜景！
看到聂鹏一脸感慨的模样，一旁的陈倩心中却是有些不以为然，区区一座小岛，即便景色再好又能好到哪里去。
很快，船只靠岸，临时搭建的码头上早已有人等候在那里，等众人都下船后，凭着自己收到的请帖，自会有人带去早已经准备好的客舍。
东海英雄会还有三天才正式召开，这三天里他们在岛上的活动自由，只要不在岛上恶意伤人就好。
隋缘身上没有请帖，只好眼看着众人被一个个的接走，站在原地有些手足无措。
“小子，跟老夫走吧。
聂鹏从隋缘身旁走过，淡淡的开口道。
说完，不管隋缘是不是同意，径直迈步向前走去。
隋缘闻言却是眼前一亮，毫不客气的跟在了李素两人身后。

陈倩见状不由得翻了个白眼。
在岛上仆役的带领下，几人来到一座位于半山腰的竹楼前，竹楼高两层，周围还有篱笆围成的一个小院子，院子的空地上种着些常见的花草，看得出来，这个院子是有人精心打理过的，院子里的花草虽不名贵，长势却是很好，整座竹楼内外也都被人打扫的一尘不染。
“老夫住二楼，你们随意。
“聂鹏留下一句话后便径直去了二楼，李素面带笑意的看向身后的隋缘，却见他正好奇的四处打量。
这座竹楼虽然比不上城主府的奢华，但却是清淡素雅，自有一番风味，这让从小没见过什么大世面的小乞丐再次开了眼界。
‘切。
’陈倩心中有些鄙夷的哼了声，直接迈步走进竹楼，选了左边的房间推门走了进去。
“随兄先请。
“李素笑着伸手向隋缘示意了一下。
隋缘见状愣了愣，看向李素，露出了自己的小白牙，“不着急不着急，“隋缘笑着说到，”
我先去周围转转。
说着，在李素有些诧异的目光中转身向院子外面的竹林走去。
看着隋缘的背影，李素微微摇了摇头，选了陈倩对面的房间。

Shi Jing Yingxia
The Changdaomen's change of ownership did not spread to Pingchuan City at all, but the cancellation of the marriage between Changdaomen and Wuyinting became a hot topic in Pingchuan City.
Elder Li of Wuyinting left Pingchuan City with his people the day after he came to Pingchuan City. After that, except for sending people to take back the invitations sent before, the Zhao family stayed behind closed doors.
The entire Changdao Sect seemed to be isolated from the rest of the world. Even if guests who were familiar with the Zhao family and his son came to visit, Changdao Sect sent an old butler to apologize, but the Zhao family and his son never showed up.
While the people in the city were talking about this, on the sea, the ship Sui Yuan and his party arrived on Yingxia Island, where the Heroes Meeting was held.
This Yingxia Island is a small island with a radius of more than ten kilometers located due east of Donghai County. Originally, only a few hundred people lived here for generations. Later, the old man Donghai lived in seclusion here, but he also taught a few disciples and made a big name in the world.
As the ship gradually docked, most of the passengers on the ship came to the deck to look at the isolated island hanging overseas. It was noon, and the sun was shining warmly. Everyone squinted and looked at the small island in front of them, but they didn't see anything surprising.
On the top floor of the ship, Nie Peng, Li Su, and Chen Qian were standing on the terrace outside the door, also watching the famous Yingxia Island in the rivers and lakes.
As the second leader of the Five Tiger Gang in Jing'an City, Nie Peng was certainly qualified to occupy a room on the top floor, but Li Su and Chen Qian were able to stay on the top floor because of Nie Peng's influence.
"The terrain of Yingxia Island is high in the west and low in the east," Nie Peng said with emotion, looking at the island surrounded by blue water in front of him.
The best place with the best scenery is the 'Mirror Viewing Platform'. Every day at sunrise, the rising sun jumps out of the sea and reflects on the stone wall. The scenery is truly a scenic spot on earth!
Seeing Nie Peng's expression of emotion, Chen Qian on the side was a little disapproving. It was just a small island, no matter how good the scenery was, how could it be any better?
Soon, the ship docked, and there were already people waiting there on the temporary dock. After everyone got off the ship, based on the invitations they received, someone would take them to the guest house that had been prepared.
The East China Sea Heroes Association will be officially held in three days. During these three days, they can move freely on the island, as long as they do not maliciously hurt anyone on the island.
Sui Yuan didn't have an invitation on him, so he had to watch everyone being picked up one by one, standing there at a loss.
“Boy, let’s go with me.
Nie Peng walked past Sui Yuan and said calmly.
After saying that, Sui Yuan walked forward regardless of whether he agreed or not.
Sui Yuan's eyes lit up when he heard this, and he followed Li Su unceremoniously.
Chen Qian couldn't help but roll her eyes when she saw this.
Under the leadership of the servants on the island, several people came to a bamboo building halfway up the mountain. The bamboo building was two stories high and surrounded by a small yard surrounded by fences. Some common flowers and plants were planted in the open space of the yard. It could be seen that the yard had been carefully taken care of. Although the flowers and plants in the yard were not expensive, they grew well. The entire bamboo building was cleaned spotlessly inside and outside.
"I live on the second floor, you can do whatever you want.
"Nie Peng left a word and went straight to the second floor. Li Su looked at Sui Yuan behind him with a smile, only to see him looking around curiously.
Although this bamboo building is not as luxurious as the city lord's mansion, it is simple and elegant, with its own flavor. This has once again opened the eyes of the little beggar who has never seen much of the world since he was a child.
'cut.
’ Chen Qian snorted with some contempt in her heart, walked directly into the bamboo building, chose the room on the left, opened the door and walked in.
"Brother, please come first.
"Li Su smiled and stretched out his hand to indicate to Sui Yuan.
Sui Yuan was stunned when he saw this, looked at Li Su, and showed his little white teeth, "Don't worry, don't worry."Anxious," Sui Yuan said with a smile,"
I'll go walk around first.
With that said, under Li Su's somewhat surprised gaze, he turned and walked towards the bamboo forest outside the yard.
Looking at Sui Yuan's back, Li Su shook his head slightly and chose the room opposite Chen Qian.
